report_site_name: Terminal de Regaseificação de São Paulo (TRSP), Santos
suggested_othernames: Terminal de Regaseificação de São Paulo (TRSP), Santos
basis: Same terminal: 3.7 MTPA both; Santos/São Paulo; FSRU fleet table p.43 lists vessel 'Höegh Giant' deployed at Santos, Brazil — GEM Cosan FSRU carries 'Höegh Giant'. GIIGNL just names the terminal by its regulatory name (TRSP).

Same terminal: 10.0 MTPA both. GIIGNL owner cell 'Gas Blue Sky Holdings, Hebei Natural Gas' = the PetroChina Jingtang terminal's minority shareholders (PetroChina Jingtang 51%, Beijing Gas Blue Sky 29%, Hebei Natural Gas). The PetroChina terminal sits at Caofeidian port. (Distinct from the Xintian/Suntien terminal also at Caofeidian — see Suntien resolution.)

GDLNG = Guangdong Dapeng LNG (the acronym). China regas; GIIGNL owners (Guangdong Energy, Shenzhen Energy, HK & China Gas, HK Electric, Foshan Gas, Guangzhou Gas) are the Dapeng shareholders. Web search confirms GDLNG stands for Guangdong Dapeng LNG.

Same terminal: 5.0 MTPA both. 'Suntien' = China Suntien Green Energy = 新天 = GEM's 'Xintian'; owner Hebei Construction & Investment Group is Suntien/Xintian's parent (controls Caofeidian Xintian LNG 51%). Phase 1 operational 2022.
Same terminal: 0.2 MTPA both; GIIGNL owner cell names 'HiGas: Avenir LNG'. HiGas operates the small-scale FSU terminal at Oristano (Santa Giusta), Sardinia.

Owner CNTIC VPower (GIIGNL 'CNTIC VPower / VPower Global / China National Technical Import Corp') matches GEM MCV LNG Terminal (owner CNTIC VPower). The MCV LNG-to-power terminal is at Thanlyin/Thaketa, Yangon. NOTE status conflict: GEM has it MOTHBALLED, GIIGNL 2026 lists it operating (0.5) — route to Update to verify.

Same terminal: owner Gazprom; 2.0 MTPA; FSRU fleet table p.43 lists vessel 'Marshal Vasilevskiy' (Gazprom) deployed at Kaliningrad, Russia — GEM 'Marshal Vasilevskiy FSRU'. NOTE status conflict: GEM has it IDLED, GIIGNL 2026 lists it operating — route to Update to verify.

Genuinely not found in GEM. Owner 'Huafon Group' (华峰集团, a Wenzhou-based group), 1.0 MTPA, start 2025, at Zhuangyuanao (状元岙) port, Wenzhou. Distinct from GEM's existing 'Wenzhou Huagang' (Huagang Petrochemical) and 'Wenzhou' (Zheneng) terminals — different owner. Route to Discovery; verify it isn't an expansion of an existing Wenzhou terminal before adding.
